integrity: An exact algebraic proof is included; exhaustive computations over 28 selected finite fields are supplementary, not a proof in untested fields. Prior-work comparison is not a global novelty certificate.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite characteristic other than 7; distinct finite-field roots only; the curve point count is not reduced to an elementary universal formula; no uniform claims over unexamined small characteristics.
title: Elliptic root spectra for cubic Ankeny–Brauer–Chowla polynomials
